note: A single site on a small dirt pad in a brushy opening east of Billy Lewis Road, with the driveway entrance 2.2 miles from US 6 to the north and about 2 miles from PA 44 to the south. The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 020 Palmatier still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 30 ft, back-in dirt driveway 30 ft, grades Slight; count 1 and 30 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA leaf-off): pin on a small dirt patch about 15 m across at the end of a dirt track roughly 70 m long leaving the east side of the forest road, in a brushy opening with scattered trees; pin on site. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Surface: Dirt', 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 20'. No Severe grade, no 4WD or wet-weather statement, no closure. Kept. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

Figures: 'Max Vehicle Length: 30' and 'Equipment Length: 30' beside 'Length of shortest side of spur to the wheelstop: 20' on a 30 x 25 ft site with a 30-ft driveway. Max Vehicle and Equipment Length are over 23 ft but the spur figure is under it: kept at 30 ft with all figures in the sites note.
Driveway length: the page lists 'Driveway Length: 30', while imagery shows the pad at the end of a track roughly 70 m long from the forest road. Observation only; nothing written from it.

ATV check (ruling 1): the site page(s) say nothing about ATVs and do not call the ground a parking area. The DCNR Susquehannock ATV Trail brochure names five trailheads (District Office, Sunken Branch, Route 44, Rock Run, Lyman); none is this site. The camp at the Rock Run trailhead is a separate site, '029 Rock Run ATV' in the DCNR GIS layer, not part of this entry. Kept. The DCNR ATV page says the Susquehannock ATV Trail connects to the Sweden Township roads 'near the intersection of Billy Lewis Road, Irish Farm Road, and U.S. Route 6', which by the page's own directions is 2.2 miles north of this site's driveway.
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own name and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: 020 Palmatier, Billy Lewis Rd'); nothing to change.
Equestrian check: the Susquehannock camping page names the Dyer and Horsey Hilton equestrian areas; this entry is neither and its page(s) list no horse category.

Susquehannock advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office closure Oct 17-18, 2026; Rausch Road reopened July 31, 2025; 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice, and nothing on this entry's road. The camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation.
